name: AI SEO Masterclass - Module 4 LLM Citations The New Backlinks
body:
> Lesson · 2026-10-08

# Summary
"Brand mentions are the new backlinks." The module contrasts how Google weighs links with how LLMs weigh mentions, then teaches a citation portfolio, citation velocity and a monthly citation report.

# Google links vs LLM citations (per the lesson)
- Google: link authority, anchor text, months to impact, must be indexed.
- LLMs: mention frequency, context and semantics, recency critical, link optional, days to impact.

# Four citation types (share of citations quoted)
1. Listicle placements (43.8%), the gold standard; being #1 in many lists makes you the default answer.
2. Contextual mentions (28.3%): brand + what you do + who it is for + a benefit.
3. Research/data citations (15.2%): publish original stats that others quote ("quote bait").
4. Social/forum mentions (12.7%): Reddit, Quora and similar.

# DIY citation plan (target 50 in 30 days)
10 guest posts, 20 web 2.0 posts (Medium, LinkedIn, WordPress.com, Blogger, Substack), 10 forum mentions, 10 directory listings; 40 to 60 hours, $500 to $2,000. Index via GSC, social shares, indexing services, optional tier-2 links. Maintain monthly (check live), quarterly (replace lost), annually (full audit).

# Citation velocity
Month 1 foundation 20 to 30, month 2 40 to 60, month 3 60 to 100, then 20 to 30 per month. A steady 30 per month beats a one-time burst of 100.

# Quality scorecard
Context 40%, placement 30%, source authority 20%, freshness 10%. Aim for 12+ of 20 points. Provide a ready-to-quote one-line description (what, who for, key benefit).

# Tracking
Google Alerts, weekly manual "brand + best / review / vs / alternative" searches, Trackings.ai, GA4 AI referrals, monthly citation report (new vs lost, by platform, top citations, traffic, actions, next month).

# Useful pro tips
Unlinked-mention harvest (ask for the link), competitor citation gap, refresh outreach on 6 to 12 month old listicles, monthly "ask ChatGPT and screenshot" audit.

# How this applies to TAG clients
- Legit pieces for local clients: consistent business descriptions, real local PR, chamber and association listings, original data (for example job-based stats the owner approves).
- Mass-generated network articles that rank a client #1 are paid placements in disguise; treat as off-limits without Scott's approval.
- A monthly AI-citation check fits the [SEO Tracker](lib:brain-seo-tracker) refresh.
